topic.title: Topic / Subject
topic.description: The documentary subject to explore and write about.

language.title: Language
language.description: Output language. Use 'en' for English or 'th' for Thai.

documentary_style.title: Documentary Style
documentary_style.description: The documentary approach that shapes narrative structure and perspective.

include_interview_segments.title: Include Interview Segments
include_interview_segments.description: Whether to include realistic interview quotes from fictional experts and subjects.

word_count.title: Maximum words (optional)
word_count.description: If provided, the script must not exceed this word count. Overrides length preset.

reference_images.title: Reference Images
reference_images.description: Optional array of reference image URLs. When provided, visual context from these images will be incorporated into the documentary script.

response_mode.title: Response Mode
response_mode.description: Choose 'markdown' for readable text or 'cms_json' for structured CMS output.

target_audience.title: Target Audience
target_audience.description: Describe the intended audience for the article.
